services.desc: Need some help with your casting or maybe want to perfect the double haul? Maybe you have a particular fly pattern or fly tying technique that is giving you fits. Let us help you! Our experienced instructors are available by the hour for private instruction on just about any subject related to fly fishing. Private One-Day Schools availalbe for groups of 1 or more anglers and equipment can be provided! If you're new to fly fishing and want to learn the basics of fly casting or if you're an experienced veteran looking for feedback and tips to perfect your technique, we are here to help with 1-on-1 fly casting lessons.
